name: symbol
description: Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) stock ticker symbol

name: market_cap_category
constraints: Allowed values: Large Cap, Mid Cap

name: fiscal_year
description: Fiscal accounting year of the reported financial statement

name: revenue_pkr_million
description: Gross revenue or turnover / markup earned for banks (in Million PKR)

name: profit_before_tax_pkr_million
description: Profit or loss before taxation / pre-tax income (in Million PKR)

name: tax_expense_pkr_million
description: Total tax provision including corporate tax

name: profit_after_tax_pkr_million
description: Net profit or loss after taxation / bottom line (in Million PKR)

name: effective_tax_rate_pct
description: Effective tax rate calculated as (tax_expense / profit_before_tax * 100)

name: total_assets_pkr_million
description: Total balance sheet asset valuation (in Million PKR)

name: super_tax_applicable
description: Indicates applicability of Section 4C Super Tax on high-earning persons/entities
